articles.title: Alien Messages Might Be Hiding in a Cosmic Blur
articles.summary: Imagine shouting through a windy tunnel — your voice gets blurry. New research says stars do the same to alien radio signals, making them harder for us to catch. Scientists at the SETI Institute found that plasma around stars can smear narrow signals into a wider, quieter blur.

articles.title: Meet Bruce, the One-Beaked Boss of the Kea Circus
articles.summary: Bruce the kea parrot is missing his upper beak, but that hasn't stopped him from becoming the top bird at a New Zealand wildlife reserve. He wins every fight and gets first dibs on food. Scientists say he's the first disabled animal known to lead a group without help.

articles.title: Superconductors Just Got a Super Boost from Tiny Ridges
articles.summary: Superconductors can move electricity with zero waste, but they usually need extreme cold. Scientists in Sweden found a trick: by adding microscopic ridges to the surface beneath a superconductor, they made it work at higher temperatures and resist strong magnets.
